examples.name: List users in a merchant portal
examples.description: Lists users for a merchant. This operation requires a partner key.

examples.name: Create a user in a merchant portal
examples.description: Creates a merchant portal user. Use a partner key and a valid phone number.

examples.name: Remove a user from a merchant portal
examples.description: Removes a merchant portal user. The username can be the user's email address. This operation requires a partner key.
